label: Hurricane — Austin Fab offline
blurb: The headline case: two customers lose supply directly and Penang is starved of test fixtures, pulling Die Sorting down with it.

label: Typhoon — Penang Assembly offline
blurb: Penang is single-source for Die Sorting, so nothing here can be rerouted.

label: Supplier failure — Hamamatsu Photonics
blurb: One supplier feeding two plants at once, which is why the ripple is wide but shallow.

label: Partial loss — Dresden Fab at 60%
blurb: Dresden has the least headroom in the network and is sole source for E-Beam Review.

label: Lane closed — San Jose to Penang
blurb: Both plants keep running; only the lane stops. Penang still loses a third of its inbound volume.

label: Demand spike — TSMC +60%
blurb: Tests headroom in the other direction: two plants go over 100%.
